milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the mossy stone bricks structure (centered at spawn-relative 5, 1, 4) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. The structure spans (4,0,3) to (7,2,6) relative to spawn. max_distance=8 allows the player to be anywhere within clear visual range of the 4x4x3 structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure, not just passing by.
